clusterAggregation.high: any sample in the cluster is high
clusterAggregation.correct: every high sample is same-scene and has circular yaw error at most 45 degrees
clusterAggregation.catastrophic: any high sample is wrong-scene or has circular yaw error above 90 degrees
clusterAggregation.evaluable: every canonical sample in the cluster is adjudicated evaluable

stoppingRule: Add authorized clusters until all four adjusted bounds jointly pass or the separately registered no-go budget is exhausted.
exclusions: Ambiguous, multi-solution, blur, and evaluability rules are frozen before predictions and cannot be changed after results.
